headline: Goldman Sachs Cuts Year-End Gold Forecast Amid Hawkish Fed Shift
summary: Goldman Sachs lowered its year-end gold price forecast following a hawkish shift in expectations for the Federal Reserve's monetary policy.
why: Goldman Sachs' commodity research is widely followed by institutional investors, and revisions to precious metal forecasts can trigger reallocations in gold-backed exchange-traded funds and futures.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Goldman Sachs lowered its year-end price forecast for gold.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A hawkish Federal Reserve outlook raises real interest rates, increasing the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.
